openings.claim: Make the existing paper exception slip a current-location record: the evening clerk updates an exception whenever its book moves, including placement under another household surname. This proposes a testable function, not an established pickup improvement.
openings.delta: Replace the once-before-opening exception snapshot with movement-coupled entries linking the requesting reader, book and present location. Keep the slip behind the desk and consult it before searching elsewhere; change no storage layout.
openings.prediction: In a future stipulated-window probe, recorded exceptions remain accurate after moves and their pickups require fewer second-location searches. The full requirement remains unproven: at least 95% of all available pickups within two minutes, no wrong-reader handoffs and no identity exposure.
openings.rival_prediction: The nearest alternative explanation is that burst demand and identification problems dominate delay, while stale locations are incidental. Even an accurate slip would then leave the overall two-minute failure rate largely unchanged.
openings.defeat: Accurate entries accompanied by unchanged second-location searches defeat the retrieval mechanism; achieving fewer searches but missing the 95% target, making any wrong-reader handoff or exceeding ten daily preparation minutes defeats full-task qualification.
openings.probe: First conduct a clerk-only rehearsal behind the desk using existing paper, shelves, cart and timing sheet. Follow temporarily displaced holds through moves, check slip accuracy and retrieval times, and count all slip preparation and correction work against ten minutes; stop at that limit. A rehearsal cannot establish evening queue performance or handoff correctness.
assumptions: A reliable behind-desk source linking requesting readers to individual books is available; the fixture does not verify that capability.
The clerk can recognize and update every relevant movement within the unchanged ten-minute preparation budget.
Consulting the slip remains fast during the observed demand burst. No constraint relaxation qualifies the intervention.
